messages:
Morgan: RC ready for origination — rc-20240712.1 built from release/candidate. Artifacts: s3://redwood-artifacts/rc-20240712.1.tar.gz

deploy-bot: Candidate created: rc-20240712.1 (CI: ✅) | artifacts uploaded | smoke: staged-smoke-24 OK

Dina: Quick note — DB migration flag still set to `false`. No schema changes. I ran the basic smoke locally, looks good. :+1:

Alejandra: Ran end-to-end on perf-qa. There's a flakey auth2 test (timing) — not blocking. Suggest slim canary: 3% traffic for first 20m, then 10% for 40m before gradual ramp if metrics are green.

sre-oncall: I'll stand by. Setting SLO dashboards and alerts: latency (p95), error-rate (>1% alarms), CPU/GPU hotspot. Also will warm KV cache 10m before traffic shift.

Samir: Please pin artifact to avoid mid-roll race. Pin to deploy tag `rc-20240712.1-pin` and update release notes with SSH-friendly rollback steps.

Morgan: Pinning now. Running the pin script.

Morgan (script output):
```
# pin artifact
curl -X POST https://deploy.internal/pin -d '{"artifact":"rc-20240712.1","pin":"rc-20240712.1-pin"}'
Response: 200 OK
```

Alejandra: Adding the rollback play in release notes:
```
# rollback
deploy-bot rollback --to rc-20240711.9 --reason "promo revert"
kubectl -n prod set image deploy/web web=image:rc-20240711.9
```

Dina: Confirming docs: release-notes/2024-07-12.md updated with change log and rollback steps.

sre-oncall: Starting KV warmup job on canary nodes now. ETA 8m.

deploy-bot: Promotion plan queued by @morgan. Quiet window: 22:00-23:00 UTC. Canary schedule: 0->3% at T+0, stay 20m, 3%->10% at T+20m, stay 40m, ramp to 50% at T+60m if stable. Rollback automatic on error-rate >1.5% or p95 > 500ms.

Alejandra: ACK from QA: manual smoke green, feature toggles set to default off for risky flags.

Samir: @sre-oncall when you see sustained errors, hit the deadman switch: `/deploy deadman revert rc-20240711.9` — I'll be on call for rollback coordination.

sre-oncall: Copy. Will open an incident channel if thresholds exceeded. :mag:

Morgan: Proceeding to promote to canary now.

deploy-bot: Starting promotion to canary: rc-20240712.1 -> canary group (3%).

deploy-bot: Promotion step result: 3% traffic routed to rc-20240712.1. KV warm status: warmed. Smoke probe: PASS.

Alejandra: Watching logs, no error spike. :eyes:

Dina: Observability looks good. No DB errors.

sre-oncall: p95 latency steady. Error-rate 0.2%.

Samir: Pin confirmed and release notes published. Preparing hotfix branch in case rollback needed.

Morgan: Thanks team. We'll keep this thread as the runbook for the promotion. If anything happens, reply here. :rocket:
